question: What subjugating effect on a woman is guaranteed by the daily honey-smeared flower oblation?
premises: The oblation described in the previous verse is performed.
The target woman is affected as if pierced by the five arrows.
The text asserts the absence of doubt.
inference: This oblation makes a woman, her body pierced by the five arrows, into a maidservant without doubt.
plain_english: By this practice, one makes a woman whose body is pierced by the five arrows into a maidservant; there is no doubt.
